visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-column intro: chapter label + heading on the left, lead paragraph and key/value metadata on the right
notes: Side-by-side layout: heading column beside lead paragraph and metadata. Section background equals page background, so no style.

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 = label paragraph + H2; cell 2 = lead paragraph + metadata paragraphs

usage: Two-column intro: chapter label + heading on the left, lead paragraph and key/value metadata on the right.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any two-column label/heading + body text intro with equal column widths.

blockStructure.notes: One row, two cells, each holding text/images/buttons/titles; no nested blocks.
